about_the_game:
In the heart of the Amazon jungle, myths become deadly reality. You wake up alone, and the only way to survive the night is to capture the elusive Saci by finding five objects scattered across the dense, ever-changing forest. Saci is always hunting you, using tricks to alter the environment and lead you astray. Known for his mischievous nature in Brazilian folklore, Saci warps reality, setting traps and illusions to confuse you. With danger at every turn, can you outwit the jungle's trickster spirit before it’s too late?

Survive the night or become another victim of the jungle’s deadly legend.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Environment: Explore the Amazon Jungle with realistic weather and wildlife.

  • Saci’s Tricks: Face visual pranks and shifting landscapes designed to confuse you.

  • Stealth and Survival: Avoid wildlife predators while gathering the objects.

  • Exploration: Discover hidden caves, ancient ruins, and unravel the jungle’s secrets.

Who is Saci?

The game draws from Brazilian folklore, where Saci-Pererê is not only a mischievous trickster but also one of the guardians of the Amazon forest. Known for his one-legged figure, magical red cap, and pipe, Saci controls whirlwinds and alters the jungle to confuse travellers. In this version, Saci’s dark past as a former enslaved child who lost his leg adds a tragic edge to his pranks. He warps the environment with illusions and traps to stop you from capturing him. Survive and find five objects to trap Saci and escape his cursed domain.
